title: fix(platform-objects): hide Resend Invitation on a cloud-managed environment
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92RMf51Kdq6B1SCtfWLQzZt)_

Fixes #33758
Clause-②: no — it narrows where one action is offered; no acceptance set or public export widens
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「重新发送邀请」(Resend Invitation) 在云托管环境里不再出现，和「邀请用户」的四处入口、「复制邀请链接」一样隐藏；非托管环境照旧显示。
- 为什么改：托管环境的成员只从身份提供方进入，邀请接口在托管环境一律返回 409，重新发送也不例外；按钮留着只会让管理员点了看到冲突错误。
- 风险与回滚：只给一个操作加了一个可见性条件，并在功能开关登记表里登记；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据或接口变化。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts`（新增的 `visible` 一行）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`（`cloudManaged.gatedInputs` 新增一条）、`identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`（新钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 Resend Invitation 的托管隐藏用例在列。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_invitation.resend_invitation` gains `visible: 'features.cloudManaged != true'`, the same authored term the four `invite_user` mirrors carry. A resend is a call to `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`, which plugin-auth's before-hook refuses on a cloud-managed environment with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` whatever the body says, resends included. The lowered predicate becomes `((features.cloudManaged != true) && INVITE_REACH) && features.organization != false`, matching the mirrors.
- `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.cloudManaged.gatedInputs` books `sys_invitation.actions.resend_invitation`, as `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` requires of every `features.*` reference (its reverse walk reds an unbooked one; its forward row now holds the action to the gate).
- Root changeset `.changeset/33758-hide-resend-invitation-cloud-managed.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/spec`.

## Tests

- New block in `identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`, evaluated through `@objectstack/formula`'s CEL engine on the parsed object: Resend is hidden on an unexpired pending row and on a pending row past its `expires_at` while managed, offered on both as before when the flag is off, and still hidden when `organization` is off.
- Forced test edit: `platform-objects.test.ts`, the lowering row for `SysInvitation.resend_invitation` now expects the managed term first (`((MANAGED) && INVITE) && ORG`), the same shape as the `invite_user` rows. The row pins the served predicate byte-for-byte, so it has to move with the gate.
- Not edited: `invitation-delivery-copy.test.ts` keeps its "Resend stays offered on a pending row past its expires_at" pin green unchanged (it evaluates with `cloudManaged` unset, which reads as unmanaged).

## Acceptance notes

- `resend_invitation` carries no `status` term of its own; which rows it appears on is decided by the list views that project it (the pending view). Unchanged here, noted only because the card's Facts say "offered on a pending invitation row".
